title: Sep 6 Results: 66.7% Win Rate Tells the Story
summary: Sep 6 results: 10-5 record with 66.7% accuracy across 15 games analyzed

content.value:
## The Numbers From September 6th

Let's talk data. We went 10-5 on Saturday's slate, hitting 66.7% accuracy across 15 predictions. That's 1.7 percentage points above our target threshold, and when you're dealing with sample sizes like this, every decimal matters.

## Confidence Level Breakdown

Here's what the distribution tells us: We had 6 picks at 60-61% confidence and 2 coin-flip scenarios at 50%. The 60%+ confidence picks went 5-3 (62.5%), while our 50% picks split exactly as probability would predict at 1-1. Statistical variance at work.

## Where We Hit

The strongest performances came from our 61% confidence tier. The Sox, Guardians, and Diamondbacks all delivered exactly as the models projected. That's a 75% hit rate on our highest-conviction plays (excluding one miss on the Rays). The Braves pick at 60% also cashed, giving us solid returns in the upper-confidence bracket.

## Where We Missed

The misses: Brewers at 53%, Giants at 60%, Cubs at 60%, and Rays at 61%. That Rays loss stings from a confidence standpoint—61% projections should hit more than they miss. But here's the reality: in a 61% scenario, you're still expecting losses 39% of the time. Over 100 such picks, we'd anticipate 39 losses. We got one today.

## Tomorrow's Slate

No games scheduled for September 7th. The league takes a collective breath, and so does our prediction engine. We'll be back with fresh data, updated models, and a full slate of projections when action resumes.

**The Bottom Line:** 66.7% is above threshold. The model performed within expected parameters across confidence tiers. Sample size matters, and one day's results don't define a season—but they do provide valuable calibration data.

Numbers don't lie. We'll let these speak for themselves.
